data.data_quality_notes: No explicit aggregate GROSS prior-year reserve movement (movement in prior years' provision) was located. Narrative explicitly states reserves strengthened but does not quantify a gross amount. A gross claims development triangle is present but its layout (aggregate '2013 & prior' column, missing intermediate years, and RITC activity) creates ambiguity for automated extraction; therefore prior_year_development is left null. Opening gross claims outstanding and gross premiums are taken from the technical reserves note and income statement respectively (clear GBP 000 values).

_claims_triangle.notes: A gross claims development table is present in the notes (labelled 'Gross Basis GBP m'), but the triangular layout includes an aggregate '2013 & prior' column and omitted intermediate years (2019-2021), and the RITC activity noted in the report distorts straightforward diagonal comparisons. Due to alignment ambiguity and the presence of aggregate columns, the development rows have not been transcribed for automated computation of prior year development.
